Functional description

According to the battery voltage control logic described previously, the Body Computer M1 supplies the luggage compartment light G40 from pin 33 of connector E and also the sun visor lights - driver's side G31 and passenger side G32 ;the glove compartment light G30 is supplied in the same way from pin 16 of connector C.

The boot lid opening switch I11 sends an earth signal with the boot open and lights up the courtesy light G40 .

The glove compartment light G30 is lit up with an earth signal from the glove compartment switch I15 .

The 'low battery voltage' signal which switches off the courtesy lights if they are on, reaches the Body Computer M1 via the CAN line E1050
